thesis: The speaker argues that most investors dangerously focus on maximizing leverage to minimize equity, which often leads to stacking debt and forcing poor decisions during downturns. Instead, the firm defaults to an all-equity structure with no senior debt, using only modest seller debt to provide leverage while aligning the seller's interests with the business's long-term survival.
